$comment: Backticked snake_case identifiers that skill markdown may mention even though they do not exist in the published OpenAPI spec. Every entry needs a reason. Anything not listed here and not found in the spec fails test/spec-drift.test.mjs — add an entry only when the identifier genuinely lives outside the spec (an MCP tool, an MCP-only field, a key prefix), never to paper over a spec mismatch.
$comment_mcp_tools: Tools on the hosted MCP server. Not in the OpenAPI spec because they are MCP tools. whoami is not listed because the identifier check only matches snake_case names with an underscore. Reasons for the ones without a one-to-one REST twin:

$reasons_mcp_tools.get_test_api_key: credential handoff into the project env file — MCP-only by design
$reasons_mcp_tools.list_events: one tool over the three REST event listings plus wait_seconds polling
$reasons_mcp_tools.get_deliverables: merges the deliverable list and per-deliverable GET so URLs are fresh
$reasons_mcp_tools.update_webhook: MCP webhooks PATCH — webhooks have no public REST surface
$reasons_mcp_tools.upload_file: attached-file upload on hosts that pass files to tools; mint_upload_url elsewhere

$comment_mcp_tool_inputs: wait_seconds is a list_events input, not a REST field.
$comment_mcp_tool_outputs: timed_out is a list_events output field, not a REST field.
